ACCESSIBLE MEDIA TRANSCRIPT

Three views of
one recorded comparison.

The 24-second video uses still images of the actual application, each visible for eight seconds. It has no audio and does not represent calculation speed.

0 to 8 seconds

Board explorer shows the complete original ULX3S front board and selects U1/J16. The other 1,176 pads supply context and remain unsolved. The selected copper diameter is 400 µm. Original EMARD, RADIONA and FER silkscreen is retained.

8 to 16 seconds

The 40 nL reference shows X/Z forces of −184.526/−181.284 µN. The 56 nL candidate shows −164.385/+13.386 µN. At the hypothetical 300 µm held gap and 240 µm offset, the candidate restores laterally less strongly and pushes upward. The fixture objective requires restoration without upward separation.

16 to 24 seconds

The expanded Candidate result lists the volume, gap, offset, material, signed forces and exact input identity. A readable review and numerical archive preserve the assumptions and receipts for inspection and replay. The qualification remains visible. Physical force accuracy is unqualified.
